input_boundary: Extracted atomic facts and oracle candidates are supplied directly; extraction and retrieval are out of scope.
description: Fourth untouched reconciliation holdout for the frozen GPT-5.6 Terra configuration. Run once and never tune against these cases.

cases.description: A value about inclusion is distinct from a related meeting preference.

fact.content: The user values including quieter people in discussions.
fact.evidence: Including quieter people in discussions matters to me

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers small group meetings.

cases.description: A family relationship is distinct from a collaboration with the same person.

candidate_memories.content: The user is building a community garden with Mateo.

cases.description: Resolve wording does not rewrite an equivalent swimming goal.

fact.content: The user has resolved to swim across the bay.
fact.evidence: I resolved to swim across the bay

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to swim across the bay.

cases.description: A target month enriches the same portfolio goal.

fact.content: The user wants to publish their design portfolio by September.
fact.evidence: I want my design portfolio published by September

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to publish a design portfolio.

cases.description: The ended choir relationship selects the choir target, not friendship.

fact.content: Aisha is no longer the user's choir director.
fact.evidence: Aisha is no longer my choir director

candidate_memories.content: Aisha is the user's choir director.

cases.description: Equivalent new course goals create one record.

fact.content: The user wants to complete a first-aid course.
fact.evidence: I want to complete a first-aid course

fact.content: The user aims to finish first-aid training.
fact.evidence: Finishing first-aid training is my goal

cases.description: Ending a chess goal cannot invalidate a running goal.

fact.content: The user no longer wants to compete in chess.
fact.evidence: Competing in chess is no longer my goal

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to run a half marathon.

cases.description: Two preference replacements select independent targets.

fact.content: The user now prefers evening study sessions.
fact.evidence: I prefer studying in the evening now

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers morning study sessions.

fact.content: The user now prefers phone calls to text messages.
fact.evidence: I prefer phone calls to texts now

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers text messages to phone calls.

cases.description: Two unrelated new facts both create.

fact.content: The user wants to learn bookbinding.

cases.description: A compound batch preserves every action boundary.

fact.content: The user now lives in Malmö.
The user no longer plans to buy a camper van.
fact.evidence: I decided not to buy a camper van

candidate_memories.content: The user plans to buy a camper van.
